page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.e3.7xlarge is an x86_64 compute instance operating under the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile supplies 32 dedicated vCPUs alongside 256.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB per vCPU allocation. The instance contains no GPU accelerators, directing all platform resources to standard instruction processing and large-scale memory management.

Storage configuration on this instance requires external network block devices, as it features no bundled local disk storage. The instance also provisions zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses by default. Architectural tradeoffs center on this storage abstraction: applications require decoupled network storage volumes for file systems and data retention, which focuses host efficiency purely on CPU and memory utilization.

From a cost-efficiency standpoint, the platform yields dense RAM capacity per core without the added expense of idle local NVMe devices or dedicated graphics hardware. These specifications align directly with memory-bound enterprise deployments, such as in-memory databases, distributed caching tiers, large-scale ETL jobs, and big-data analytics platforms.

By concentrating hardware provisioning purely on core computation and high memory capacity rather than auxiliary accelerators or local solid-state drives, ecs.e3.7xlarge delivers cost-effective resource allocation for memory-heavy operations. It is well matched for in-memory databases, distributed caching clusters, large enterprise applications, and data preprocessing pipelines.
